messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "started in hospital if have cirrhosis with fluid in abdomen"
set: ["started in hospital if have cirrhosis with fluid in abdomen", "treatment is started in hospital and increased slowly for cirrhosis", "started in hospital because sudden shifts in fluid and salt can affect brain function", "call doctor if have blood in urine", "call doctor if have burning in eyes", "rinse with water if gets in eyes", "call doctor if have swelling in face or throat", "given into abdomen only", "tell doctor if have or had low sodium levels in blood", "can be started with an injection into a muscle", "rinse with water if spray gets in eyes or mouth", "tell healthcare provider if living in household with small children", "tell doctor if blood in urine", "inject into the abdomen or thigh", "use with caution in people drinking heavily", "dose titration in patients with renal impairment"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
